title: Snowflake Features: Time Travel, Cloning, Streams & Tasks

scenes.heading: Time Travel, Cloning, Streams & Tasks
scenes.narration: Snowflake bundles four powerful features that make data recovery, testing, and pipelines dramatically easier.

scenes.heading: The four features at a glance
bullets: Time Travel: query or restore data as it looked in the recent past.
Zero-copy cloning: instantly copy a table or database with no storage cost.
Streams: track row-level changes for change-data-capture pipelines.
Tasks: schedule SQL to run on a cadence or in dependency chains.
scenes.narration: Time Travel lets you look back at previous versions of your data and recover from mistakes. Zero-copy cloning duplicates objects instantly by sharing storage until data diverges. Streams capture inserts, updates, and deletes, and Tasks schedule the SQL that processes them.

scenes.heading: Recovering with Time Travel
scenes.narration: The AT clause queries the orders table exactly as it existed an hour ago, which is perfect for auditing a bad change. UNDROP brings back a table you dropped by accident, as long as you are within the retention window. The final statement clones the table instantly, giving you a private copy to experiment on without duplicating storage.

scenes.heading: Building a CDC pipeline
scenes.narration: A stream sits on a source table and records every row that changes. A scheduled task then reads from that stream and applies the changes to a target table. Because consuming the stream advances its offset, each run processes only the new deltas.

scenes.heading: Cloning vs copying
scenes.narration: A normal copy physically writes every byte again, doubling storage and taking time on big tables. A zero-copy clone instead points at the same micro-partitions and only stores new data as the clone diverges. That makes spinning up dev and test environments essentially free and instant.

scenes.text: Time Travel protects you from mistakes, cloning makes safe copies free, and Streams plus Tasks automate CDC pipelines.
scenes.narration: Together these features give you painless recovery, instant environments, and fully automated change-data-capture pipelines.
